Covid makes it worse. I am in hell. I'm so alone, and that's true even when I'm amongst other people.  I have insane abandonment issues, but simultaneously this painful feeling of inability to connect when people are open.  When people aren't open, there is no learning experience, because ghosting doesn't tell you much about the situation unless you can figure it out on your own, and I mainly don't figure a thing out except to get more paranoid.

Some people get ghosted looking for sex, and I'm not looking for that, and it makes me feel even sadder to not be looking for it.  I just want to have some human connection.  Honestly, most sex I've had was to try and have someone that felt they couldn't just leave me as easily.

This is not a plea for attention, or at least not one that is a hope for salvation, just a warning.  All that comes from places like this subreddit is people that feel saying "don't kill yourself" does something in itself.  All that does is tell the person to wait for help that isn't coming.  Saying that a person is dealing with a temporary problem or that things get better is sadistic when things tend to get worse.

I'm so bad at life that I'm terribly scared of how to accomplish death.  I don't want my head to explode via shotgun, because my father died without a funeral and I think for some people a closed casket is worse than an open one.  But for handguns I'm too stupid to understand if a small caliber or large caliber really makes a difference if shooting myself through my upper palate in my mouth.  I've looked into other options, but they're even scarier - I think of Mark Linkous overdosing, but waking up paralyzed from his leg oxygen being cut off.  A failed suicide that leaves you unable to attempt again is the worst fate.

This is all while my body is continuously accompanied by death.  I'm nowhere close to dying, but the health issues I have make me so much lower than what I would consider a living person.  Every morning I wake in pain, and most of the day is depression and physical pain, until the night that I spend in high anxiety about what dreams would come if I fall asleep, or maybe I'm just afraid of the people who rape you when you're vulnerable.

It doesn't get better.  If you are holding out for a miracle, no miracle is coming.  End it now, the world has evolved to be tooth and claw, never ending pain, and people self righteous in sociopathy.

Every birthday for me is just depressing, as I was supposed to die years ago, and nobody even cares that I’m still here anyways.  In fact, my birthday has literally been ignored throughout my whole life.  I’ve only had one decent birthday, and now it’s just a bittersweet memory because it was all lies. 

Anyways, so I’ve basically given up on life.  I don’t really see a future for me, as the future I had envisioned for years all came crashing down and destroyed my sense of reality.  

I’m also stuck right now.  My parents are basically holding me hostage, and I feel like a loser and a failure.  I lie to people who question why I ride the bus, or don’t have a job, or still live with my parents.  It’s not like I’m “lazy” or “stupid.”  I don’t even know why that would be the first thing to come to mind about these things, as cars are expensive and housing in my state is horrendously high.  I actually have problems, and my parents are psychotic.  It’s easier to explain that I ride the bus to save money on gas, or say that I’m just living with them until I get enough money for an apartment.  In fact, I had a job once.  I had a car once.  I had an apartment once too.  But I lost all those things because of mental illness and being a fucking stupid idiot.  Now I’m stuck here with my parents, who won’t let me get a job, a car, or mental help.  I rather stay here and suffer than be homeless again, ik, I’m weak.  I rather just die at this point.

Plus, I’ve been winging it for awhile.  I planned on dying years ago, and ever since I failed the first time.  The only future I planned out was with my bf, who I now refer to as an abusive ex, because he severely damaged me.  A lot of people severely damaged me.  Where’s their punishment?  Where’s their damage?  I’ve tried to not think about it, but I feel so fucking angry about it.  I guess me caring is just me being stupid again. 

I also feel like my reason for killing myself this time is stupid.  Last time I killed myself, it was because my ex abused the shit out of me and felt worthless.  Now it’s just because I’m scared of life, which people do everyday just fine.  Why can’t I just be fucking normal.  I’m pathetic.

text: Suicidal Thoughts Are Calming to Me Ever since I was 13 I thought about it every damn day and I'm not overexaggerating in the slightest. Whenever I get stressed or angry instead of counting to ten or doing breathing exercises, I fantasize about putting a bullet through my head. I don't have a gun but if I did, I'd probably blow my brains out of impulse or on a really bad day. I know One thing that stops me from killing myself now was the fact that I formed somewhat of a parasocial relationship with someone I grew close to. Even after he explained in his suicide note how he was a serial cheater and had emotionally manipulated people, I was still sad that he died. I sort of saw it coming since he did copious amounts of drugs and had a history of child abuse, but I think to myself (and excuse me if I sound selfish right now) that if I don't think he deserved to die then I don't think I deserve to die either. I've just watched my life pass by I've moved around a lot in my life, and that has resulted in leaving a lot of friendships behind at first. Now, I haven't had any solid friends in 8 years and I'm 21, how depressing is that? Spent high school with fake friends (except for 1 person who I like but we are drafting apart), spent college with no friends and I'll be graduating soon. It has been utterly gutwrenching watching the people I went to elementary and middle school with still being in each others lives on social media, while they have certainly forgotten that I exist. I wish I'd lived in the same place my whole life because I had amazing friends before moving and even after my family's first move, but not since then. Some of this lack of friends could be due to us getting older and people becoming clique-y, but I am so depressed by it. Been in a psych ward 3 years ago. Been on antidepressants since then too. Life is still shitty and if there was to be a car accident, I would accept death with open arms. I have even thought about driving off the road, but can't harm anyone else or leave my parents with a shitty insurance/cleanup scenario. Oh yeah, did I mention I'm an only child who came after SEVEN failed IVF cycles??? Like fuck, killing myself now would just be cruel to my parents, but why must I suffer???

That was a long rant, and I am sorry, but I am seriously just numb at this point, I wish I could cry but I am just gone for. Waste of a life. Ready to die. I'm so shitty that I'm even posting this in the hopes of getting some final attention. What a jerk. 

Well, I'll be here for the next 20-30 years, depending on how long before both my parents pass and I can leave this world without guilt.

Don't take the pills.
